hypotheses.title: Subindustry Operating Income Yield Valuation Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Comparing a company's operating income against its stock price (operating yield = operating_income / close) over a multi-month rolling lookback identifies companies experiencing operational profit growth that the market has not yet fully reflected. Normalizing operating income by price in TOPSP500 with Market neutralization and decay=4 isolates large-cap valuation underreaction, unlocking an elite Fitness of 1.55 ('GOOD' platform rating), Sharpe 1.58, ultra-low 7.90% turnover, and 0.2707 self-correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if high operating yield is driven by permanent business impairment where stock price collapsed due to insolvency risk.
